{"ops": [{"insert": "一个人做软件评测站，月入五位数"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 1}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他 accidentally 上了Product Hunt，结果拿了当日第一", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "你有没有 accidentally 做成过什么事？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Francesco D'Alessio accidentally 把产品发布了。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他本来只是想预约一下Product Hunt的发布日期，结果忘了这回事。等他想起来的时候，产品已经上线了。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "更离谱的是——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "当日排名第一。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "一、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Francesco背景很普通。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "做营销的，搞销售的，没什么技术背景。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但他有个本事：特别会挑软件。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "别人找工具，在Google搜半天，下载一堆垃圾。Francesco扫两眼就知道哪个好用。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "2020年，他决定把这个本事变现。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "花了一个周末，他用Notion+Super+Tally搭了个网站。零代码，纯拼凑。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " backend是Notion，frontend是Super，表单用Tally。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这就是Tool Finder的雏形。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "然后他设置了Product Hunt的预约发布。本来打算好好准备一下，做个隆重的 launch。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "结果忘了。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "等他想起来，产品已经在线上跑了。用户开始涌入，投票，留言。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他就这么"被动"地正式发布了。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "二、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "第一个版本撑了两三周。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Francesco发现，要想做好SEO、想要专业感，这套拼凑的方案不行。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他重新开发了网站。这次更像那么回事了。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "商业模式也清晰起来——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "赞助 + 联盟营销 + 会员折扣。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "软件公司付钱让他在网站上推荐产品。用户通过他的链接购买，他拿佣金。会员还能享受独家折扣。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "三线并进，收入稳稳的。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "现在Tool Finder月入五位数。他还有个小产品Bento，也快四位数了。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "三、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "最让Francesco后悔的事是什么？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "雇了太多人。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "一开始他请了视频剪辑、内容写手，还找了个技术合伙人。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "现在回头看，这些都不是必须的。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": ""业务规模没那么大，我一个人就能搞定。""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他悟出一个道理："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "别过度招聘，别扩张到不熟悉的地盘，专注做你擅长的事。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "现在的Francesco，一个人管内容、做视频、维护网站（靠AI辅助），顺带开发App。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "全栈 solo founder。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "四、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "最近三个月，Francesco有了个转变。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "以前他躲在内容后面，不露脸。现在他开始大量做YouTube，真人出镜。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": ""我发现大家喜欢友好、易懂的软件讲解。""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这招很管用。视频帮他建立更强的供应商关系，还能提前拿到独家新闻。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他也更懂自己了。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": ""理解你的工作方式，这一点太重要了。""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他说，你越了解自己怎么运作、怎么适应、怎么从错误中学习，业务结果就越好。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "五、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Francesco现在正处于转型期。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Tool Finder要改版，Bento和Scrum Planning要升级，还在筹划一系列帮助人们建立自信的小工具。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "有人问他对AI怎么看。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他说了句挺有意思的话："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": ""在AI时代，创造力会更重要。你的睡眠、健康、思考方式、身体状态，都会影响你的创造力。""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "所以他的建议是——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "先理解你自己。跟自己独处，理解自己的系统。这会改变你的产出方式。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "写在最后"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Francesco的故事没有惊天动地的转折。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "就是一个普通人，把自己擅长的本事，打包成一个产品。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " accidental launch 反而成了最好的 launch。因为产品本身有价值，时机对了，用户自然就来了。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他让我想到一句话——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "你不需要万事俱备才开始。有时候，"不小心"发布了，反而是最好的开始。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "当然，前提是你东西确实做得不差。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "原文来自Indie Hackers，由AI翻译并改写", "attributes": {"italic": true}}]}
content_en: One person runs software review site earning five figures monthly. He accidentally got first place on Product Hunt. Have you accidentally achieved something. Francesco D Alessio accidentally released product. He originally just wanted to schedule Product Hunt launch date forgot about it. When he remembered product was already online. Even more ridiculous. First place that day. One. Francesco background is very ordinary. In marketing sales no technical background. But he has one skill particularly good at picking software. Others search tools on Google for half day download bunch of junk Francesco scans two eyes knows which is good. Twenty twenty he decided to monetize this skill. Spent weekend built website using Notion plus Super plus Tally. Zero code pure patchwork. Backend is Notion frontend is Super forms use Tally. This was Tool Finder prototype. Then he set up Product Hunt scheduled launch. Was planning to prepare well do grand launch. Then forgot. When he remembered product was already running online using.
